verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a separate test environment and recommends testing the full client-side and server-side integration there with test credentials before going live. That separation carries into agent tooling: the MCP server runs with `--env=TEST` versus `--env=LIVE`, the agentic Feed API has distinct test and live base URLs, and client keys are scoped per environment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that test data is isolated from production data, detail on test payment methods and simulated scenarios, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
